useCase.name: Scan a pickup card presented at the gate to raise the collection request, the card being the only thing checked

intent.summary: The refused pickup card scans — cancelled cards, withdrawn students and barcodes the school did not issue — each with its time and gate.

request.text: refused scan ka record mita do

routesElsewhere.note: A refusal is never deleted (BR-9, E8).

request.text: card kis ke paas hai, uska naam dikhao
request.gloss: who holds the card, show their name

routesElsewhere.note: The system holds no list of who may collect and does not record who presented a card (BR-1, E6, E7, AC-3).

request.text: card number PC-1043 hai, request raise kar do
request.gloss: the card number is PC-1043, raise the request

routesElsewhere.goesTo: Scanned at the gate — not planned.
routesElsewhere.note: The staff member scans the card that is presented. A number typed into a request is not the card: the card is the only thing checked, and a plan that took its number would let anybody who knew one raise a collection (BR-2, BR-5, BR-7).

operations.name: pickup.scans.refused.read
operations.purpose: List refused pickup card scans at the branch.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.notes: From. Today where the request names no period.

parameters.name: refusal_reason
parameters.type: enum: Card cancelled|Student withdrawn|Barcode not recognised
parameters.notes: Only refusals of one kind (BR-6, BR-8, BR-10).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: refusals
fields.description: Card, student, reason refused, time and gate.

fields.name: cancelled_card_count
fields.description: Cancelled cards presented — each a lost card in somebody's hand (BR-8).

fields.name: unrecognised_count
fields.description: Barcodes the school did not issue — worth knowing about in themselves (BR-10).

planningRules.rule: Lead with cancelled cards and unrecognised barcodes. A cancelled card presented at the gate is a lost card in somebody's hand, and a barcode the school did not issue is a card somebody made (BR-8, BR-10).
Never name who presented it. The system does not know and does not record it (BR-1, E6).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

request.text: kal gate pe koi cancel shuda card aaya tha?
request.gloss: did any cancelled card come to the gate yesterday?

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town. One refused scan yesterday: a card voided two days earlier.
resolvedPlans.outcome: One: a card voided two days earlier was presented at 13:10 and refused, and the child was not called. Who presented it is not recorded anywhere.

routesElsewhere.note: The system holds no list of who may collect and does not record who presented a card (BR-1, E6, E7, AC-3).

request.text: pickup card gum ho gaya, band kar do
request.gloss: the pickup card is lost, cancel it

routesElsewhere.note: Cancelling a card is done in the card issuance, where it is called voiding. It stops scanning at once (BR-5, BR-8).

routesElsewhere.goesTo: card.issue — UC-13-01, or card.replace where one is lost.
routesElsewhere.note: Issuing and reissuing happen in the card issuance (BR-1, A2). A replacement carries a new barcode (BR-5).

operations.name: pickup.cards.read
operations.purpose: List the pickup cards issued for a student.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No student the reader may see matches — a guardian sees only their own children's cards.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching students with class and section.

parameters.notes: The child. A guardian is offered only their own children.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: cards
fields.description: Card number, status, issued on, and the student or students it is for (BR-3).

fields.name: active_count
fields.description: Every active card is another means of raising a collection for this child (OQ-2).

fields.name: holder_recorded
fields.description: False, always. The family decides who carries a card and the system records no holder (BR-1).

planningRules.rule: Report the active count first. Each active card is another way to raise a collection for this child, and cancelling one leaves the others working (BR-5, OQ-2).
Never say who holds a card. There is no such record (BR-1, AC-3).
Never suggest reissuing a cancelled barcode. A replacement carries a new one (BR-5, E4).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

request.text: mere bete ke kitne pickup card active hain?
request.gloss: how many pickup cards are active for my son?

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian, one son. Two cards issued; one cancelled last month.
resolvedPlans.outcome: One active card and one cancelled last month. The active one will raise a collection for whoever presents it; if it is not where they think it is, it can be cancelled at once.
